result.summary: Removes legacy reverse-precedence code from settings merging in `src/common/settings.cpp`. Under older behavior, the first configuration file assignment of an option took precedence over subsequent assignments; with #17493 disallowing duplicate assignments in the same section, this reverse-precedence rule becomes redundant.
